title: AFC Help
subtitle: Answers from the AFC guides, any time
greeting.in: Hi {name}. I can answer questions about tournaments, teams, transfers, rankings and rules, and about your own account.
greeting.in2: If I can't sort it out, I'll pass the chat to a person.
greeting.out: Hi. I can answer questions about tournaments, teams, transfers, rankings and rules.
greeting.out2: Sign in and I can also check your own team and registrations.
chips.leave: Why can't I leave my team?
chips.window: When does the next transfer window open?
chips.person: I need to talk to a person
placeholder: Ask about AFC or your account
writing: AFC Help is writing an answer
signInFallback: Sign in and I can check your account.
personFallback: A person should look at this. Press Talk to a person and the support team will pick it up.
foot.left: AI answers can be wrong. {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} left today.
person.introIn: I'll open a support ticket and attach this chat, so you won't have to explain again.
person.introOut: Where should the support team reply? I'll attach this chat to the ticket.
person.messageLabel: What do you need help with?
ticket.done: Done. I've opened a support ticket and attached this chat, so you won't have to explain again.
ticket.doneNoChat: Done. Your support ticket is open.
ticket.existing: This chat is already with the support team. I've added the latest messages to your ticket.
ticket.replyIn: A support admin will reply by email and in My tickets.
ticket.replyOut: A support admin will reply to {email}.
errors.limit: You've used today's {limit} questions. You can ask again tomorrow, or open a ticket and a person will reply.
errors.networkLimit: Too many questions have come from your network today. Sign in to keep asking, or open a ticket and a person will reply.
errors.offline: The assistant is offline right now. You can still open a ticket and a person will reply.
errors.busy: The assistant is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.slowDown: Slow down a little, then ask again.
errors.timeout: The assistant took too long. Try again.
errors.failed: The assistant could not answer that. Try again, or talk to a person.
errors.network: Could not reach AFC. Check your connection and try again.
errors.botCheck: We could not confirm you are a person. Complete the check and send again.
errors.conversationGone: That conversation has ended. Ask again to start a new one.
errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address the support team can reply to.
errors.handoffEmpty: Tell us what you need help with.
errors.handoffLimit: You've opened several tickets in the last hour. A person will reply to those.
errors.ticketFailed: The ticket could not be opened. Try again, or use the form on the Support page.
